Synopsis:
    China's SPIC Brasil has contracted a Chinese consortium (Dongfang Electric + China Gezhouba Group) to expand the Sao Simao hydroelectric plant by 310 MW for ~$272M. The expansion, awarded at Brazil's March capacity auction, is expected to come online in 2030, pushing the plant past 2 GW total capacity. This is framed as an asset optimisation strategy for Brazil's renewable energy build-out.
